_doc: Claim-pillar x incident-pillar relevance matrix. Encodes how strongly an incident in one pillar should weigh against a claim in another pillar. 1.0 = full weight (same pillar); 0.5 = half weight (related); 0.2 = quarter weight (unrelated). Used by core/penalty_decay.py to gate penalty contributions before they enter the regulatory_R / controversy aggregation. Designed to fix the audit finding 'Dieselgate dominating climate-target claims' — a governance scandal should not flatten an environmental claim to the same extent as an environmental incident would.

rationale.environmental_tau_8: Climate / pollution incidents have long memory; investor concern persists past a decade.
rationale.governance_tau_4: Governance scandals lose informational value faster as boards / leadership turn over.
rationale.active_override: An active lawsuit is by definition unresolved — no decay applied until it settles.
